$comment: One-line purpose for every source directory. Consumed by scripts/generate-map.mjs to build MAP.md. A directory with no entry here is emitted as UNDESCRIBED and makes `npm run map -- --check` fail — add the line rather than letting the map go vague. Keep each value to one sentence, present tense, describing responsibility (not file list).
src: Extension entry point; delegates everything to src/client/activation/.
src/client: Shared client-side helpers used across every VS Code-facing feature.
src/client/activation: One module per feature, each wiring its commands, views, and services on extension start.
src/client/console: Kopytko Console controller and severity/line classification for debug output.
src/client/console/views: Console panel view provider (tree/webview host registration).
src/client/console/webview: Kopytko Console webview: xterm.js terminal, completion, colouring, filtering.
src/client/debug: Debug Adapter Protocol implementation and the session controller driving a Roku debug run.
src/client/debug/services: Debug session sub-services: breakpoints, source-path mapping, variable inspection.
src/client/deepLinking: Deep-link launch controller and saved parameter-set storage.
src/client/deepLinking/webview: Deep Linking webview: parameter editor and launch form.
src/client/deviceManager: Device Manager controllers: remote control, keyboard mode, saved text entries, script runner, abilities hub.
src/client/deviceManager/editorWebview: RASP script editor webview hosted in an editor tab.
src/client/deviceManager/rasp: RASP script format: parser, runner, and shared types.
src/client/deviceManager/webview: Device Manager webview: remote UI, abilities, script controls.
src/client/diagnostics: Runtime diagnostics panel controller (transports live in packages/roku-device).
src/client/diagnostics/session: Diagnostics session lifecycle: start/stop, active-channel tracking.
src/client/diagnostics/storage: NDJSON session persistence and replay loading.
src/client/diagnostics/views: Diagnostics panel view provider and message routing.
src/client/diagnostics/webview: Diagnostics webview: uPlot charts, tables, navigator/brush.
src/client/nav/views: Kopytko Tools navigation sidebar view provider.
src/client/network: Network Inspector controller plus body formatting, text diffing, and DNS bypass.
src/client/network/capture: Intercepting proxy: https<->http bridging, flow records, cURL export.
src/client/network/capture/rewrite: Request/response rewrite rule engine (map-local, headers, latency, block).
src/client/network/discovery: Gateway IP detection used to scope the transparent redirect.
src/client/network/redirect: Transparent redirect orchestration and privilege elevation.
src/client/network/redirect/windows: Windows WinDivert companion: bundled binary resolution, script, supervisor.
src/client/network/storage: Network capture session persistence (HAR and session store).
src/client/network/webview: Network Inspector webview: flow list, detail pane, compare, breakpoints.
src/client/nodes: SceneGraph node tree panel and RALE node-path resolution.
src/client/nodes/webview: Node Tree webview: tree, XML view, edit mode.
src/client/perfetto/webview: Perfetto webview hosting the trace UI iframe (PING/PONG handshake).
src/client/roku: Kopytko-specific device glue kept out of packages/roku-device: CLI deployer and .kopytkorc reader.
src/client/roku/discovery: VS Code-side device discovery wiring over the package SSDP client.
src/client/roku/rendezvous: Rendezvous log collection and the shared-queue coordination it needs.
src/client/roku/util: Device-side path to workspace source-file resolution.
src/client/rokuPay: Roku Pay Web Services client, endpoint catalog, credential profiles, request history.
src/client/rokuPay/webview: Roku Pay webview: request builder and response viewer.
src/server: LSP server entry and handler registration.
src/server/brightscript: Server-side BrightScript analysis: function index, XML script parsing, m.top resolution, casing, formatting config.
src/server/kopytko: Kopytko-specific server logic: @import resolution, module catalog, unit-test framework support.
src/server/providers: The LSP feature providers (completion, hover, definition, rename, semantic tokens, ...).
src/server/providers/completion: Completion sub-builders split by context: members, imports, tests.
src/server/providers/shared: Symbol resolution shared by definition, hover, references, and rename.
src/server/services: Cross-cutting server services: cache invalidation on watched-file changes, workspace-level component diagnostics.
src/server/utils: Server performance layer: document/parse caches, workspace indexes, stubbable fs wrapper.
packages/brightscript-parser/src: Lexer, CST, typed AST, and diagnostics — the single source of truth for per-file structural facts.
packages/brightscript-parser/src/analysi: Scope and semantic analysis over the AST: call graph, context, symbols, type inference.
packages/brightscript-parser/src/catalog: Static BrightScript catalogs: built-ins, ro* components, SceneGraph nodes, casing, numeric literals.
packages/brightscript-parser/src/utils: Parser-side helpers: glob matching, position math, XML parsing.
packages/formatter/src: Formatter engine, configuration, and casing rules.
packages/formatter/src/cst-passes: Structure-aware formatting passes applied over the CST, one concern per file.
packages/linter/src: Linter core: rule running, config, suppression, fixing, project indexing.
packages/linter/src/analysis: Per-file analysis the rules consume: function index, imports, siblings, XML, text utils.
packages/linter/src/catalog: Linter-side catalogs for built-ins, components, and test globals.
packages/linter/src/rules: Rule registry split into syntax-level and AST-level rule sets.
packages/linter/src/rules/ast: AST rule implementations, one rule (or closely related group) per file.
packages/roku-device/src: Public API surface for all Roku device communication; deliberately Kopytko-unaware.
packages/roku-device/src/console: Debug console transports (TCP 8080/8085) and the interactive command catalog.
packages/roku-device/src/debug-protocol: BrightScript remote debug protocol (TCP 8081): framing, binary IO, commands, client.
packages/roku-device/src/diagnostics: Diagnostics event model shared by parsers and collectors.
packages/roku-device/src/diagnostics/col: Polling collectors, one per metric stream (chanperf, node counts, textures, rendezvous, ...).
packages/roku-device/src/diagnostics/par: Pure parsers for each device response format (chanperf, sgnodes, free, r2d2_bitmaps, ...).
packages/roku-device/src/discovery: Device discovery orchestration over SSDP plus storage and network-change hooks.
packages/roku-device/src/ecp: ECP REST client (HTTP 8060): queries, key simulation, registry, tracing control.
packages/roku-device/src/installer: Developer web-admin automation over HTTP 80 (install, rekey, package, screenshot, reboot).
packages/roku-device/src/net: Low-level HTTP with digest auth and multipart, plus network identity.
packages/roku-device/src/rale: RALE TrackerTask client for live SceneGraph node editing.
